title: External orders
subtitle: Review signed order requests before accepting them. Receiving a request does not create a sale, collect payment or reserve stock.
noSite: Select an active site to manage external orders.
select: Select an order to review its items and next action.

connectors.title: Order connectors
connectors.sandboxOnly: Generic signed sandbox contract. This is not a certified integration with a delivery platform or aggregator.
connectors.name: Connector name
connectors.saveOnce: Save this key securely in the sending system. It will not be shown again after saving. Never include it in screenshots or support messages.
connectors.savedConfirmation: I saved this key securely for the sending system.
connectors.rotating: Replace the signing key for {{name}}. The old key stops working immediately after saving.
connectors.empty: No connectors configured for this site.
connectors.keyUnavailable: The server has no connector wrapping key. Configure PUNTOVIVO_EXTERNAL_ORDER_KEY or the database encryption key, then restart the server. Production still requires database encryption.
connectors.randomUnavailable: Secure key generation is unavailable in this browser. Use HTTPS or the desktop app.

quote.title: Local price review
quote.differs: The local total differs from the source quote. Resolve the difference with the source before accepting.
quote.draftOnly: Acceptance reserves stock and sends configured kitchen work, but does not collect payment. Complete payment from suspended sales. Any service charge is reviewed at checkout.
quote.confirm: I reviewed the local products, quantities and prices and confirmed them with the source.

detail.tombstone: The source cancelled before order details arrived. This order will not be reopened automatically.
detail.findDraft: Select the suspended sale labelled {{reference}} to resume, collect payment or discard it.
detail.cancelRequested: The source requested cancellation. Checkout and delivery are blocked. Discard an unpaid draft or issue a full return from the linked sale before resolving this request. No refund is automatic.
